**Introduction to Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd.**

Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is a leading innovator in the chemical industry, specializing in the research, development, production, and distribution of high-performance chemical materials. Headquartered at **No. 136, Qingchun Road, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China**, the company has established itself as a trusted partner for businesses across diverse sectors, including construction, coatings, adhesives, textiles, and industrial manufacturing. With a strong commitment to technological advancement and sustainable practices, Runhe Chemical has earned a reputation for delivering premium-quality products that meet the evolving demands of global markets.

Founded on a foundation of scientific expertise and industrial excellence, the company integrates cutting-edge R&D with state-of-the-art production facilities to ensure superior product performance and reliability. Runhe Chemical’s extensive product portfolio includes polyurethane raw materials, synthetic resins, specialty chemicals, and eco-friendly solutions, all designed to enhance efficiency, durability, and environmental compliance. By adhering to stringent quality control standards and international certifications, the company ensures that its offerings align with the highest industry benchmarks.

Beyond its core operations, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical is dedicated to fostering long-term partnerships through exceptional customer service, technical support, and customized solutions. With a global vision and a customer-centric approach, the company continues to expand its reach, contributing to the advancement of the chemical industry while upholding principles of innovation, integrity, and sustainability. As a dynamic and forward-thinking enterprise, Runhe Chemical remains at the forefront of chemical innovation, driving progress in both domestic and international markets.
